notes:
What's new in 0.9.251 (beta)
- Shared track lines: laps shared at Advanced or Elite build a pooled track line (the road's position and width, never tied to you); the terms say so (EULA v1.7, Privacy v1.15).
- Sector times keep going: stop and restart the sector HUD in the same session and it keeps its laps and best sectors.
- Highlights: the Process button keeps its size beside the TV-angles picker, and "Your video is ready" shows this sim's reel.
- Narrow windows: at phone width the top bar fits when you are signed in.
- Overlay resizing: a size you drag while a menu is open stays, and the bar-only overlay has a resize grip clear of the close button.
- Session notes: a notes save that fails is kept and retried, with no false "changed elsewhere" conflict.
- Spanish: the Rivals hint, reference labels, fuel calculator and beta badge date are in Spanish.

Also new since 0.9.244 (0.9.245-0.9.250 were not released separately)
- PRO GOAT map fit: the corner map fills its card, turned to fit; the corner lists put the time beside the turn; the satellite inset is fitted and centred.
- Engineer Dashboard on a laptop: the dashboard fits one screen from 1280 to 1920 wide; lists show what fits and charts draw at real size.
- Satellite map placement: GOAT places the satellite image under each track automatically and hides it only when it measurably does not fit.
- Sector times from the line: on an iRacing standing start the sector times are right from the first lap, and every sector shows a gap.
- Race highlights: a race's highlights end on the chequered-flag crossing; the Highlights waiting list is one table, and the TV-angles picker is one grid.
- Overlay menus fit: a small telemetry overlay grows to show an open menu or panel and gives the height back when it closes.
- SMART on time: a corner verdict is said before the next corner or not at all, and a word you repeat is heard once.
- Lap table: the distance column reads "lap %" (100%, 65%), and the legend quotes the real clean-lap band (95–115% of the best lap).
- Coach names your lap: the coach names the loaded lap by its own number ("Race 9").
- Beta badge date: the beta chip shows your beta's own end date, with the year when it is not this year.
- GOAT Dash speed up top: on the phone dash your speed sits in the top-centre box with RPM small under the gear, and the tyre panel's "set … kPa" labels stay clear of the border when a long pit-lane message shows.
- Overlay sets on the Live bar: start, save, rename and delete your overlay sets from the Live bar; a successful "Update this set" shows "Updated <name>".
- Shift & Boost in one window: the shift lights and boost overlays are one window with one menu entry; your old Shift or Boost sets open it.
- Bar-only overlay: the telemetry overlay can shrink to just its title bar (gear menu, View); GOAT remembers it.
- Sector times on track: on iRacing each sector time flashes up as you cross its line.
- Engineer Dashboard layout: the track map sits beside the field, turned to fit its card, with a gain / hold / loss trail.
- GOAT Dash offers: SMART's offers on GOAT Dash appear as a pop-up card, never on the rev lights.
- Highlights per sim and per race: each Highlights tab lists only its own sim's sessions, and a session with two races gives each race its own clips and video.
- Overlays stay put: a flashing taskbar button no longer hides your overlays.
- Assetto Corsa setup match: SMART matches the setup on the car by its camber and never names a setup file it only guessed.
- Clean exit: GOAT no longer crashes when it closes with the microphone on.
- Community auto-share: once you accept the sharing terms, every clean lap is shared to the Community Data Network and your earlier laps are added quietly.
- Session names on your phone: the companion app shows each session's real name (practice, qualifying, race) instead of "Session 2".
- SMART remembers the session: SMART keeps what was said earlier in the session, re-says an answer when you ask again, and reads out the chequered lap and laps finished in the pits.
- Setup changes from the car you are driving: on Assetto Corsa SMART starts every setup change from the setup on the car (asks when it can't tell). On track it says one short line and leaves the rest for the stop; never on the grid.
- Grid radar: on iRacing the pace car is never drawn, and each car in the other column is drawn once.
- Highlights: one tick box picks all of a session's clips, "Spotted in the field" moments can go in or out of the race reel, and GOAT warns you when the sim's replay is too short to keep your race.
- Corners overlay: tick which lights to show; your choice is saved.
- SMART volume up to 150: louder without distortion; muting says "SMART muted" first, and SMART always starts unmuted.
- Overlays: a "Show overlays" / "Hide overlays" button in the pits, GOAT Dash saves with an overlay set, overlays stay on top of a windowed sim, and the Basic / Racer / Pro quick starts are gone.
- Easier sign-in: the desktop sign-in waits 15 minutes, and pressing Sign in again re-opens the browser tab.
- SMART remembers past sessions: ask "Have I been here before?" or "What bias did I run last time?" and SMART answers from your earlier sessions: visits, setup, best laps and where you lost time.
- Feedback on the radio: say "feedback" or tell SMART something in GOAT looks wrong; it says one short "noted" and keeps it on your PC with the session time.
- Track map times: the corner time labels on the PRO map stay inside the map and no longer overlap.
- Open replay in AC: "Open replay in AC" finds the right replay for a moment, also when practice, qualifying and race were recorded in one go.
- GOAT Dash stays quiet on track: the setup undo / revert offer shows only in the pits or garage, never while you drive.
- Pick your TV angles: on the Highlights page choose, for each moment type, how many TV angles and which ones; no pick keeps today's plan.
- Overlays in qualifying: your overlays stay on through qualifying.
- Grid radar sides: on the grid the radar draws each car on the correct side.
- Charts move the map: hovering the PRO or Coach telemetry charts moves the cursor on the track map.
- Settings gear: Settings is now the gear icon at the top right.
- Interlagos map: the Interlagos track map lines up with your racing line.
- Clean first lap on the map: no stray trail beside the map on your first lap.
- Radar reports: tell SMART a car is on the "wrong side" of the radar and it logs it as feedback.
- Quick calls before braking: a short SMART call that is finished before the next brake point is said straight away; longer calls still wait until you are off the brakes.
